Quick Questions

Investor Mode

What does the current move mean for me?

SIP Investor
Use the market pulse to understand context, but keep long-term SIP decisions tied to goals, horizon and asset allocation rather than one session.
Lump-Sum Investor
A phased allocation can reduce timing risk when volatility is elevated. Market direction alone should not replace suitability and allocation checks.
Retirement / Withdrawal
Focus on liquidity, withdrawal sustainability and asset mix. Intraday movement is secondary to sequence-of-return risk and cash-flow planning.

Live-data note
When the app is opened as a local Android file, network requests can still be blocked even though the 15-second timer is running. HTTPS hosting improves browser/PWA behavior, but PWA status alone does not provide live data. The timer now waits a full 15 seconds after each completed refresh before starting the next automatic refresh. A reliable production setup should use HTTPS plus a same-origin proxy/backend or licensed market-data feed.
